slides.title: 6 signs your website is losing you clients.
It's slow on mobile.
slides.body: If it takes too long to load, visitors leave before they see anything.

slides.title: Nobody can find how to contact you.
slides.body: No visible phone, WhatsApp or form means no message.

slides.title: It looks outdated.
slides.body: Old design makes people wonder if your business is still open.

slides.title: It doesn't show up on Google.
slides.body: If people search your service and don't see you, they find a competitor.

slides.title: It doesn't say what you do.
slides.body: Visitors should understand your offer in the first screen.

slides.title: There's no clear next step.
slides.body: Every page should end with one action: call, order, book or ask for a quote.

slides.title: Recognized a few signs?
slides.body: We redesign and rebuild websites that bring clients back.
